Item Class: Skill Gems
Rarity: Gem
Spark
--------
Lightning, Spell, Projectile, Duration
Level: 18
Mana Cost: 31
Cast Time: 0.70 sec
Critical Hit Chance: 9.00%
Effectiveness of Added Damage: 80%
--------
Requires: Level 82, 144 Int
--------
Launches a spray of sparking Projectiles that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire.
--------
Deals 4 to 75 Lightning Damage
Fires 8 Projectiles
Projectile duration is 2 seconds
--------
Place into an empty skill gem socket in the Skills Panel to gain this skill. Right click to remove from the Skills Panel.
